title: Clearing denominators in first-localization cohomology
statement: Let R,A,Aq,B,D be commutative rings in one universe, with R-algebra structures on A,Aq,B, an A-algebra structure on Aq compatible with R, and algebra structures from A tensor_R B and Aq tensor_R B to D. Assume the R- and B-module derived categories exist. Let Q be a complex of A-modules and L,K base-derived tensor cohomology models [def-pc-base-derived-tensor-cohomology-model] for Q and Aq tensor_A Q. Let uQ be an R-complex map whose degree-j component sends x to 1 tensor x. For i in Z let c be the B-linear cohomology map obtained by composing L.cohomologyIso(i), H^i of L.derived(uQ) followed by the unique universal-counit-compatible isomorphism L.derived -> K.derived, and K.cohomologyIso(i) inverse. Let S be a submonoid of A and Aq a localization of A at S. For every y in K.cohomology(i) there exist x in L.cohomology(i) and s in S such that (algebraMap(A,Aq)(s) tensor 1)*y=c(x).

source.place: Tags 06Y6 and 0DJ8, derived change of rings and the affine cohomology localization identity

proof.text: Apply the derived-unit fraction theorem to L.derived and the class obtained by the inverse of H^i of the universal comparison L.derived -> K.derived, followed by K.cohomologyIso.

Naturality of the universal comparison intertwines the derived image of localized scalar multiplication. The K.cohomologyIso_smul field identifies it with the includeLeft denominator action. Transport the numerator back through L.cohomologyIso and use the definition of localizationModelMap.

proof_origin.place: Tags 06Y6 and 0DJ8; derived fraction calculation and explicit counit-natural scalar transport (second reading R4)

lean.statement: theorem localizationModelMap_denominators (S : Submonoid A) [IsLocalization S Aq] (i : ℤ) (Q : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ) (L : ModuleCat.BaseDerivedTensorCohomologyModel R A B Q D) (K : ModuleCat.BaseDerivedTensorCohomologyModel R Aq B ((extend A Aq).obj Q) D) (uQ : (restrict R A).obj Q ⟶ (restrict R Aq).obj ((extend A Aq).obj Q)) (huQ : ∀ (j : ℤ) (x : Q.X j), uQ.f j x = (1 : Aq) ⊗ₜ[A,algebraMap A Aq] x) (y : K.cohomology i) : ∃ (x : L.cohomology i) (s : S), (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft (S := R) (algebraMap A Aq (s : A)) : Aq ⊗[R] B) • y = localizationModelMap R A Aq B D i Q L K uQ x
